page.overview:
Who is Prince Edward V?

Edward V is the third child and first son of Edward IV and Elizabeth Woodeville. He has two older sisters, one of whom is named Elizabeth as well. He has 7 younger siblings, among them a brother named Richard of Shrewsburry. Edward seems to be fond of his brother, as he asks for him when he arrives in London.

Prince Edward V is often confused with the older Prince Edward, son of King Henry VI, the King before Edward IV. However, the older Prince Edward only appears once as a ghost. To take away the confusion, many plays label them as:

Prince Prince Edward V, son of Edward IV

Prince Edward Prince Edward son of Henry VI
